Pork breakfast sausage runs {{live-unit:breakfast-sausage:lb}} a pound. Frozen hash browns run {{live-unit:hash-browns:lb}} a pound, and shredded cheese runs {{live-unit:shredded-cheese:oz}} an ounce. The tortillas and a little onion and pepper round out the list.
edits.why: ruling C: eggs (Large Eggs, dozen), breakfast-sausage (Breakfast Sausage, pork), hash-browns (Frozen Hash Browns) and shredded-cheese (Shredded / Block Cheese) are commodities at allowed units, so each batch amount becomes that food's unit price. Tortillas stay unpriced: the tortillas bid is flour tortillas of any size and its cheapest cell would understate a burrito-size tortilla. Onion and pepper are two foods in one figure, so no price.
